# AuthCost — full ledger

## Calculator
Interactive MAU / MFA / SSO cost ranking: http://localhost:4190/calculator/?mau=50000&sso=5&mfa=0
Share via query params: mau, sso, scim (SSO customers that also need SCIM / Directory Sync, default 0), org (organizations / tenants, default 0 = B2C; each SSO connection counts as at least 1), mpo (members per organization, default = fpc), mfa (0|1), fpc (SSO users per connection for per-SSO-user vendors, default 200), vo (verified-only 0|1), embed=1 for chrome-free iframe.
Embed: <iframe src="http://localhost:4190/calculator/?embed=1&mau=50000&sso=5" title="AuthCost calculator" width="100%" height="720" loading="lazy"></iframe>

34 plans, 34 verified, 13 vendors. Checked through 2026-11-07.

## Vendors
### Clerk
- id: clerk
- source: https://clerk.com/pricing
- checked: 2026-11-07
- unit: MRU
- summary: Hobby free to 50k MRU/app. Pro $25/mo ($20 annual) with 50k MRU + 1 SSO + 1 Directory Sync. Extra SSO $75 (2–15) then $60 (16–100) and $48 (101–250). Directory Sync billed from 2027-01-01.

### Auth0
- id: auth0
- source: https://auth0.com/pricing
- checked: 2026-11-07
- unit: MAU
- summary: Free to 25k MAU with 1 Enterprise Connection, Self-Service SSO and inbound SCIM. B2C Essentials runs $35 (500 MAU) → $700 (10k) → $3,500 (50k)/mo; B2C Professional $240 → $1,600 (10k) → $3,200 (20k). B2B Essentials $150 (500) → $2,100 (10k) → $3,800 (20k) with 3 SSO connections; B2B Professional $800 → $2,400 (10k) with 5. Extra SSO connections $100/mo. Yearly = 11× monthly. Above those tiers: Enterprise, contact sales.

### Amazon Cognito
- id: cognito
- source: https://aws.amazon.com/cognito/pricing/
- checked: 2026-11-07
- unit: MAU
- summary: Essentials (default) free 10k MAU then $0.015/MAU (direct/social). Lite free 10k then $0.0055 / $0.0046 bands. Plus $0.020/MAU no free tier. Federated SAML/OIDC: 50 free then $0.015/MAU.

### WorkOS
- id: workos
- source: https://workos.com/pricing
- checked: 2026-11-07
- unit: MAU + connection
- summary: AuthKit free to 1M MAU then $2,500/mo per additional 1M. SSO and Directory Sync each: $125 (1–15), $100 (16–30), $80 (31–50), $65 (51–100).

### Stytch
- id: stytch
- source: https://stytch.com/pricing
- checked: 2026-11-07
- unit: MAU + connection
- summary: B2B pay-as-you-go: $0 base, 10k MAU + 5 SSO/SCIM included, then $125 per additional connection. Custom brand $99. MAU overage rate not published as a fixed figure on the checked page.

### Logto
- id: logto
- source: https://logto.io/pricing
- checked: 2026-11-07
- unit: token + add-on
- summary: Free: 50k MAU / 50k tokens. Pro from $24/mo: unlimited MAU, 50k tokens then $0.08 per 100 extra. Enterprise SSO add-on $48/connector. MFA add-on $48. Organizations add-on $48.

### Kinde
- id: kinde
- source: https://kinde.com/pricing/
- checked: 2026-11-07
- unit: MAU
- summary: Free $0 / Pro $25 / Plus $75 / Scale $250. Each includes 10,500 MAU; Pro overage $0.0175/MAU. Plus and Scale include unlimited enterprise SSO at no per-connection fee. Free/Pro include 1 SSO connection.

### Supabase Auth
- id: supabase
- source: https://supabase.com/pricing
- checked: 2026-11-07
- unit: MAU
- summary: Free: 50k MAU. Pro from $25/mo: 100k MAU then $0.00325/MAU. SAML SSO: 50 included then $0.015/MAU. Auth-only cost is entangled with the platform plan.

### Firebase Auth / Identity Platform
- id: firebase
- source: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/pricing
- checked: 2026-11-07
- unit: MAU
- summary: No cost up to 50k MAU (email, phone, anonymous, social), then $0.0055/MAU to 100k, $0.0046 to 1M, $0.0032 to 10M, $0.0025 above. SAML/OIDC: 50 MAU free then $0.015/MAU. SMS (phone sign-in and MFA) billed per message by region (US $0.01); first 10 SMS a day not billed. Sources: cloud.google.com/identity-platform/pricing and firebase.google.com/pricing.

### Descope
- id: descope
- source: https://www.descope.com/pricing
- checked: 2026-11-07
- unit: MAU + tenant
- summary: Free Forever $0: 7,500 MAU, 10 tenants, 3 SSO connections, no overages. Pro starts at $249/mo billed annually: 10,000 MAU then $0.05/MAU, 35 tenants then $1, 5 SSO then $50/connection. Growth starts at $799/mo: 25,000 MAU then $0.05/MAU, 100 tenants, 10 SSO then $50, SCIM. Enterprise: contact sales.

### Scalekit
- id: scalekit
- source: https://www.scalekit.com/pricing/auth-for-saas
- checked: 2026-11-07
- unit: MAU + connection
- summary: Free $0: 25k MAU, 25 orgs, 1 SSO + 1 SCIM (hard caps). Growth $99/mo: 100k MAU then $0.05, 100 orgs then $1; SSO and SCIM each 1 free then $60 (2–15), $45 (16–30), $35 (31–50), $30 (51–100).

### SSOJet
- id: ssojet
- source: https://ssojet.com/pricing/
- checked: 2026-11-07
- unit: connection
- summary: Free $0 forever: unlimited users/MAUs/orgs, no enterprise SSO or SCIM. Business: monthly list $79/conn (2–4), $72 (5–9), $65 (10–24), $55 (25–49), $47 (50–99); annual ~25% less. SSO and SCIM each count as one connection on the same ladder.

### Authagonal
- id: authagonal
- source: https://authagonal.io/pricing
- checked: 2026-11-07
- unit: MAU
- summary: Free $0: 250 active users, every feature incl. unlimited SSO + SCIM (hard cap). Starter $29/mo to 1,000 (hard cap after grace). Pro $69 to 5,000 then $0.04/user. Scale $149 to 25,000 then $0.025. Enterprise $339 for 100,000+ then $0.015 (vendor blog prices 50k MAU / 10 SAML+SCIM at $339). Yearly = Save 1 month (11× monthly). 14-day free trial on paid plans.

- scim: Not on the pricing page. No SCIM / Directory Sync on the Identity Platform pricing page (read 2026-10-31). (https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/pricing, 2026-10-31)
- status: verified
- source: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/pricing (2026-11-07)
- notes: Tier 1 (email, phone, anonymous, social): 0–50k MAU free, then $0.0055 (50k–100k), $0.0046 (100k–1M), $0.0032 (1M–10M), $0.0025 (10M+). Tier 2 SAML/OIDC: 50 MAU free then $0.015/MAU. Phone auth and SMS MFA billed per SMS sent by region (US $0.01, first 10/day not billed). Firebase pricing page: no cost up to 50K MAUs with Identity Platform, then Google Cloud pricing.

SSO and SCIM each count as one connection on the same ladder. Annual ≈25% less (not used in rankings).

## B2B organizations / tenants
SSO results assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection (members per org = SSO users per connection, default 200). Clerk: 100 retained orgs and 20 members per org free, then the B2B Authentication add-on at $100/mo ($85 billed annually) plus $1→$0.60 per extra org; Auth0: Free 5 and B2C plans 10 organizations, B2B plans unlimited; Descope: 10 / 35 / 100 active tenants, then $1 per tenant on Pro and Growth (Free has no overage); Kinde: 5 orgs on Free, 50 included on paid plans then $0.50→$0.43 per org; Logto: Organizations add-on $48/mo. Plans over a published cap are excluded. Yes for Clerk, Auth0, Descope, Kinde and Logto. At 10k users with 1 SSO customer (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection, 200 members), Clerk Pro is $125/mo because more than 20 members per org needs the B2B Authentication add-on ($100/mo); with 20 or fewer members it is $25/mo. Auth0 Free lists $0 but caps at 5 organizations. At 10k users and 150 organizations (no SSO): Clerk Pro $175/mo (incl. $150 org fees), Descope Pro $364/mo (incl. $115), Kinde Pro $75/mo (incl. $50); Auth0 Free and B2C plans are out (5 and 10-org caps). Details: http://localhost:4190/methodology#b2b-orgs

## SCIM / Directory Sync
Calculator param scim = SSO customers that also need SCIM (default 0, capped at sso). At 10k users · 3 SSO + 3 SCIM customers (assumes every SCIM customer is also an SSO customer; assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection), cheapest verified plan per vendor: Stytch Pay as you go (B2B) $125/mo incl. $125/mo SCIM; Authagonal Scale $149/mo incl. $0/mo SCIM; Scalekit Growth $339/mo incl. $120/mo SCIM; Clerk Pro $425/mo incl. $150/mo SCIM (Directory Sync billed from 2027-01-01, $0 before) and $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on; SSOJet Business $432/mo incl. $195/mo SCIM; WorkOS AuthKit $750/mo incl. $375/mo SCIM; Descope Growth $799/mo incl. $0/mo SCIM; Auth0 Essentials (B2B) $2,100/mo incl. $0/mo SCIM. WorkOS bills SSO and Directory Sync as separate connections, so a customer on both is two connections; Stytch’s 5 included connections are shared between SSO and SCIM; Scalekit bills SCIM as a separate connection (first of each free); SSOJet bills SSO and SCIM on one shared connection ladder. Not priceable with SCIM: Amazon Cognito (no SCIM on the pricing page), Logto (no SCIM on the pricing page), Kinde (SCIM coming soon), Supabase Auth (no SCIM on the pricing page), Firebase Auth / Identity Platform (no SCIM on the pricing page). Details: http://localhost:4190/guides/enterprise-sso-cost#scim

## Auth0 for Startups (promotion, not used in rankings)
Auth0 for Startups (auth0.com/startups, read 2026-10-31) gives eligible startups one year of the B2B Professional plan free, up to 100,000 MAU, with 5 Enterprise Connections, Enterprise MFA and inbound SCIM. Eligibility (Auth0’s words): venture-backed with less than $5M in funding; less than $1M in annual recurring revenue; less than two years from the date of incorporation; not valid for existing paid Auth0/Okta customers or past program members. When the 12 months end, list price applies: B2B Professional with 3 SSO connections is $800/mo at 1,000 MAU, $1,500/mo at 5,000 MAU, $2,400/mo at 10,000 MAU; above 10,000 MAU Auth0 publishes no B2B Professional price (contact sales). Not eligible? Nothing changes: list prices apply from month 1. Our rankings always use list prices. Source: https://auth0.com/startups (read 2026-10-31).

## Self-hosting (Better Auth / Auth.js)
Open-source libraries (Better Auth MIT, Auth.js ISC; Auth.js is now part of Better Auth) have no per-user fee. Costs instead: transactional email (Amazon SES $0.10/1,000 outbound), SMS (Identity Platform US $0.01/SMS reference), database/hosting and engineer hours (user-supplied assumptions). Optional Better Auth managed infrastructure: Pro $20/mo, SSO 1 connection then $50/mo each, email $0.001, SMS $0.09 (better-auth.com/pricing, checked 2026-10-31). Break-even math vs Clerk/Auth0/Firebase at 10k/50k/100k: http://localhost:4190/guides/self-hosted-auth-cost

- 2027-01-01 Clerk (fee-start): Clerk Directory Sync connection billing starts 2027-01-01 (same ladder as SSO: 1 included on Pro/Business, then $75 / $60 bands). Announced on clerk.com/pricing. [https://clerk.com/pricing]
- 2026-11-07 AuthCost (coverage-added): Added Authagonal (Free 250 MAU hard cap with unlimited SSO+SCIM; Starter $29/1k hard cap; Pro $69/5k then $0.04; Scale $149/25k then $0.025; Enterprise $339/100k+ then $0.015 — 50k scenarios select Enterprise at $339 per vendor blog; no Mid tier for 25k–100k) as a full ledger vendor. Read from authagonal.io/pricing on 2026-11-07. Yearly = Save 1 month (11× monthly). Now ranks in the calculator and on /guides/enterprise-sso-cost (no longer unread / reference-only). [https://authagonal.io/pricing]
- 2026-11-07 AuthCost (coverage-added): Added Scalekit (Free 25k MAU / 1 SSO+1 SCIM; Growth $99 + $60/$45/$35/$30 connection ladder, first of each free) and SSOJet (Free unlimited users no SSO; Business monthly $79/$72/$65/$55/$47 per shared SSO-or-SCIM connection) as full ledger vendors. Read from scalekit.com/pricing/auth-for-saas and ssojet.com/pricing on 2026-11-07. They now rank in the calculator and on /guides/enterprise-sso-cost (no longer reference-only / unread). [https://www.scalekit.com/pricing/auth-for-saas]
- 2026-10-31 AuthCost (correction): Addition/correction: SCIM / Directory Sync is now priced, from each vendor's pricing page read 2026-10-31. WorkOS bills Directory Sync as its own connection ($125 each for 1–15, then $100/$80/$65), so a customer on SSO and SCIM is two connections; Clerk includes 1 Directory Sync connection, then $75/mo each (2–15), $60, $48, billed from January 1, 2027; Stytch's 5 included connections are shared between SSO and SCIM, then $125 each; Auth0 includes inbound SCIM on Free and B2B plans; Descope includes SCIM on Growth; Kinde lists SCIM as coming soon on Scale; Cognito, Supabase, Firebase / Identity Platform and Logto publish no SCIM on their pricing pages. Before, SCIM was listed per plan but never added to totals: at 10k users with 3 SSO customers who all need SCIM, WorkOS read $375/mo and is $750/mo; Stytch read $0 and is $125/mo; Clerk Pro read $275/mo and is $425/mo from 2027-01-01. New calculator input scim= (default 0). [https://workos.com/pricing]
- 2026-10-31 Auth0 (coverage-added): Added Auth0 for Startups (auth0.com/startups, read 2026-10-31): eligible startups (venture-backed with less than $5M in funding, less than $1M ARR, less than two years from incorporation; not existing paid Auth0/Okta customers or past members) get one year of the B2B Professional plan free, up to 100,000 MAU with 5 Enterprise Connections and inbound SCIM. Shown as a note on the SSO guide, Auth0 vendor page and every Auth0 comparison with the month-13 list price (B2B Professional with 3 SSO connections: $800/mo at 1,000 MAU, $1,500 at 5,000, $2,400 at 10,000; above 10,000 MAU contact sales). Rankings still use list prices. [https://auth0.com/startups]
- 2026-10-31 AuthCost (correction): Correction: SSO and B2B answers now include organization/tenant fees and caps read from vendor pages on 2026-10-31. Clerk: 100 monthly retained orgs and 20 members per org free; above either, the B2B Authentication add-on is $100/mo ($85 annual), then $1/mo per org (101–1,000), $0.90 (1,001–10,000), $0.75 (10,001–100,000), $0.60 (100,001+). Auth0: Free 5 and B2C plans 10 organizations; B2B unlimited. Descope: 10/35/100 active tenants, then $1 per tenant on Pro and Growth. Kinde: Free 5 orgs, paid 50 then $0.50/$0.47/$0.43. Logto: Organizations add-on $48/mo. Each SSO connection now counts as 1 customer organization. Before, Clerk vs Auth0 at 10k users with 1 SSO connection read '$300/yr less than Clerk'; it is $1,500/yr (Clerk Pro $125/mo incl. the $100/mo add-on for 200-member orgs). [https://clerk.com/pricing]
- 2026-10-31 AuthCost (coverage-added): Added Firebase Auth / Identity Platform (no cost to 50k MAU, then $0.0055→$0.0025/MAU bands; SAML/OIDC $0.015/MAU after 50) and Descope (Free 7.5k MAU; Pro from $249/mo with 10k MAU + $0.05/MAU; Growth from $799/mo with 25k MAU), read from their official pricing pages. New guide: what self-hosting Better Auth / Auth.js costs instead. [https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/pricing]
- 2026-10-31 Clerk (new-tier): Clerk publishes a new enterprise SSO connection band: connections 101–250 now cost $48/mo each (was "Contact us" for 101+). Earlier bands are unchanged: 1 included, $75/mo each for 2–15, $60/mo each for 16–100; 251+ is contact sales. [https://clerk.com/pricing]
- 2026-10-31 Auth0 (correction): Correction: our earlier Auth0 data (2026-10-30) listed paid tiers only at 500 MAU and called higher volumes and B2B “custom”. That was wrong — Auth0 publishes MAU tiers: B2C Essentials $70 (1k) to $3,500 (50k)/mo, B2C Professional to $3,200 (20k), B2B Essentials $150 (500) to $3,800 (20k) with 3 SSO connections, B2B Professional $800 to $2,400 (10k) with 5. Billing rounds up to the next tier; yearly = 11× monthly; extra SSO connections $100/mo. Not an Auth0 price change — our omission, now fixed. [https://auth0.com/pricing.md]
- 2026-10-30 AuthCost (launch-seed): Initial ledger seeded from official pricing pages (Clerk, Auth0, Cognito, WorkOS, Stytch, Logto, Kinde, Supabase Auth). [https://clerk.com/pricing]
